children: Kwick Forensic Solutions shares hit the upper circuit limit on Thursday, shortly after making their debut on the SME platform of BSE, rising nearly 75 percent from the IPO price.
The stock quoted at Rs 157.50 per share, up 5 percent, which was the highest permissible trading limit for the stock during the session.
The shares were listed at Rs 150 per share, marking a gain of 66.67 percent over the issue price.
The Rs 50.77-crore SME issue had a price band of Rs 85-90 per share.
The maiden public issue of the Chennai-based crime scene investigation products and solutions provider was subscribed 272.5 times on August 31, attracting strong demand across investor categories.
Kwick Forensic Solutions entered the capital markets with the aim of raising Rs 50.77 crore through an initial public offering (IPO) of 56.41 lakh shares.
Investors placed bids for 110.04 crore equity shares against the offer size of 40.38 lakh shares through 2.17 lakh applications during August 27-31.

On the financial front, the company reported healthy earnings growth in recent years. Its profit rose 57.8 percent to Rs 13.5 crore in the year ended March 2026, from Rs 8.6 crore in the previous year.
Revenue during the same period increased 62.6 percent to Rs 105.7 crore from Rs 65 crore.
